skill.summary: Convert scientific papers, theses, technical reports, source code, figures, inventor notes, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts and attorney-facing technical disclosure materials. Use when an AI agent must mine patent points, draft or revise a Chinese technical disclosure (技术交底书), run prior-art comparison, convert Office project materials, map every claimed feature to source evidence, preserve core formulas as editable Office Math, generate claim-aligned flowcharts and methodology figures, compare a paper with an existing patent, audit support and consistency, or deliver Chinese DOCX patent/disclosure files.

review.exception_reason: SKILL.md has no license or metadata.license declaration; Unknown records that absence without rewriting upstream bytes. The Nature repository LICENSE supplies Apache-2.0 for its authored patent-drafting router, references and scripts. The bundled patent-disclosure-skill-MIT-LICENSE.txt preserves the complete MIT grant and Copyright (c) 2026 handsomestWei for incorporated disclosure material. The package contains drafting patterns and example/test data, not the source paper/patent corpus. All local routing resources are included; document generation, rendering and patent search dependencies are installed or accessed separately at runtime.
